content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for prior authorization missing at time of service. This payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review, and an appeal with necessity has already been filed. Missing auth is a provider responsibility, so the balance cannot be billed to the patient, and resubmitting would risk a CO-18 duplicate denial. With no viable payer avenue remaining, the balance is uncollectible and should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
